title: On the approximation of finite perimeter sets
summary: We prove that if $Ω\subseteq\mathbb{R}^N$ is a set with finite perimeter with $\mathscr{H}^{N-1}(\partial Ω\setminus\partial^* Ω)=0$, then any set of finite perimeter $E\subseteq\mathbb{R}^N$ can be approximated by a polyhedral or smooth bounded set $F$ in such a way that both the total perimeter of $E$ and the perimeter of $E$ inside $Ω$ are approximated by those of $F$, and the boundary of $F$ has negligible intersection with the boundary of $Ω$.
